title: Align packet-format vectors with mandatory signer EUI-64 overhead
description: Correctness review found test/vectors/packets-formats.json and generate_packets_timing.py still encode the pre-SIID signed-frame model: complete example says LLSec=0x21, body=76/on-wire=77 and packet-size/link overhead=53; per updated spec/09-packets-timing.md signed short-address frame is LLSec=0xA1 and includes 8-byte SIID, with link security base=61 bytes (and the complete walkthrough correspondingly +8). Per-mode signed overheads are likewise all 8 bytes low. The generator imports these stale values from python/src/lichen/packets/formats.py and the test compares against the same production constants, so it is self-confirming rather than an independent oracle. Update production constants/example, independent generator expectations, artifact, and tests to assert spec literals and mandatory SIID.
